description: Use this as the user's MISSION CONTROL for the whole build-system pipeline — before the first step and between every step. It thinks through how the pipeline (resource-extractor → idea-forge → architect → orchestrator → demo-studio → gate-concierge) should be used for a SPECIFIC hackathon, prepares each step's filled kickoff prompt, recommends the choices each step will ask for (which URLs and sponsors to give the extractor, target tracks, risk appetite, orchestrator review mode), verifies each step's committed artifact before the next step starts, and unblocks the user when anything gets stuck at Step 0a / 0 / 1 / 2 / 2.5 / 3. Trigger it when the user says "guide me through the build-system", "how do I use these skills", "we're entering <hackathon>", "what's next", "prepare the kickoff for <step>", "which tracks should I pick", "review the pack / brief / plan", or "I'm stuck at step X". Keep this session open across the whole hackathon — every pipeline step runs in its OWN fresh session; this is the seat the user comes back to. Do NOT use it to extract, ideate, plan, or build — it prepares, reviews, and unblocks those steps, never performs them.
